title: DBVuln3: Stack exhaustion (unbounded recursion) in fts3 exprToString() and the fts3_exprtest() debug SQL function
expected: the deep expression is rejected before serialization, as fts3_exprtest_rebalance() does
actual: SIGSEGV: exprToString() recurses 174000+ frames and exhausts the stack

title: Vuln45-16: pcache1InitBulk do-while Loop Heap Buffer Overflow When -pagecache N=-1 Produces nBulk=0
expected: no crash when the CLI passes a negative nInitPage (-pagecache 0 -1)
actual: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of size 8 in pcache1InitBulk

title: Vuln97-78: json() Heap Over-read in jsonTranslateBlobToText FLOAT5 "-" Branch
expected: no out-of-bounds read while translating the JSONB blob to text
actual: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1 in jsonTranslateBlobToText

title: SQLite: duplicate ORDER BY terms are not eliminated and force a temporary sort
expected: ORDER BY x, x is canonicalized to ORDER BY x and satisfied by the index
actual: ORDER BY x, x adds USE TEMP B-TREE FOR LAST TERM OF ORDER BY, about 1.45x slower; developer answered WONT FIX

title: Vuln64-45: JSONB-to-Text Translator Discards Payload Size for NULL/TRUE/FALSE, Injecting Phantom Array Elements
expected: 7, the same element count the raw BLOB reports
actual: 8, a phantom null element added by the text round-trip; developer: input is not valid JSONB, NOT A BUG

title: Vuln5: Stack Overflow in FTS5 Porter Tokenizer via Unbounded Wrapper Chaining
expected: the chain of tokenizer wrappers is depth-limited, no crash
actual: AddressSanitizer stack-overflow while creating an fts5 table with 50000 chained porter tokenizers

title: Vuln65-46: Compile-Time Trigger Chain Stack Overflow in codeRowTrigger
expected: preparing INSERT INTO t1 hits the trigger-depth limit instead of crashing
actual: SIGSEGV inside sqlite3_prepare_v2 with a chain of ~9000 triggers

title: Command-line app mislables some blobs as NULL
expected: the 1-byte blob x'00' is shown in the normal blob format
actual: the CLI shows it as lowercase null, because x'00' is JSONB for JSON null and textjsonb translation is on by default

title: Vuln25-4: FULL JOIN USING and NATURAL FULL JOIN Bypass Column-Level Authorizer Checks
expected: a SQLITE_READ authorizer callback for t1.x, as the plain SELECT emits
actual: no READ callback at all; the column value is returned, so SQLITE_IGNORE/SQLITE_DENY are bypassed

title: Inconsistent results for an OR of IN predicates in projection and WHERE
bug_query: SELECT (t0.c1 IN (VALUES (1), (0.5 IS true))) OR (t0.c1 IN (WITH w AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM w)) FROM t0 UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM t0 WHERE (t0.c1 IN (VALUES (1), (0.5 IS true))) OR (t0.c1 IN (WITH w AS (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM w));

title: Rowid lookup with a REAL key near 2^63 disagrees with = comparison semantics
bug_query: SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE rowid = 9223372036854775808.0;
actual: returns max-int; the OP_SeekRowid path disagrees with the table scan

title: bug(constraints): ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN REAL DEFAULT <large integer> desynchronises table and index
bug_query: SELECT group_concat(id) FROM t WHERE c = 9.2233720368547758e+18;
actual: 3; the indexed lookup misses the rows the table scan finds

title: Vuln38-19: decimal_round Loses the Carry-Out Digit and Returns Wrong Result on Carry-Past-MSD Inputs
expected: the rounded decimal string with no memory error
actual: AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow READ in decimal_result on a 32-bit build; the originally reported wrong values were an ASAN malloc-fill artifact and were retracted

title: Unexpected result by JSON functions
bug_query: SELECT count(*) FROM t1 WHERE (c1=json_quote(0)) AND (json_object('c',c1) IS '{"c":0}');

title: Vuln52-33: replace() Bounds-Check Assert Signed Integer Overflow on Large Strings Under Raised SQLITE_MAX_LENGTH
actual: UBSAN signed integer overflow abort at func.c:1583 on a debug build with SQLITE_MAX_LENGTH raised

title: FTS3/FTS4 snippet() still returns a real column for colnum = 4294967298 on a 3-column table
bug_query: SELECT snippet(ft,'[',']','...',4294967298,4) FROM ft WHERE ft MATCH 'xx';
expected: empty string, the column number is out of range
actual: CCC [xx], column 2 of a 3-column table, because the argument is truncated to its low 32 bits

title: Backward incompatible output: Order of command-line options "-header" and "-csv" changes output
expected: sqlite3 -header -csv prints the header line, as 3.51.2 did
actual: since 3.53.0, -header before -csv drops the header line

title: Inconsistent json_replace() Arity Error and Implicit-Aggregation Behavior Under WHERE 0 with Scalar-Subquery Arguments
expected: consistent behaviour across the four variants
actual: query 1 errors with json_replace() needs an odd number of arguments, query 2 returns one NULL row, queries 3 and 4 return no rows; developer: these are not really bugs
